about: Differences scripts/completeness_check.py finds that are legitimate, with the reason, per manual (<code>/<version>) and check. The check fails the weekly refresh on anything not listed here, and reports an entry here that is no longer needed.

Health01/post-20250624.ref:ICD9CM_CODE~ICD9CM_CODE2: Points to the ICD-9-CM / ICD-10-CM classification itself; the manual prints no code table for it.

Health03/legacy.ref:CARD_SEQ_NO: The 健保卡就醫序號 code table is printed in the Health01 manual, not in this one.

Health03/post-20250624.ref:FUNC_SEQ_NO: The 健保卡就醫序號 code table is printed in the Health01 manual, not in this one.

Health10/legacy.fields: The legacy manual's header says 17 fields but its table prints 18 (the 2025/06/24 manual declares 18 for the same table).

Health31/legacy.fields: The legacy manual's header says 16 fields but its table prints 17 numbered rows; all are shown as printed.

Health53/legacy.fields: The legacy manual's header says 13 fields but its table prints 14 (the 2025/06/24 manual declares 14).

Health54/legacy.fields:H_BHP_PST_MASTER: The legacy manual's header says 5 fields but its table prints 6 (ID_TYPE); shown as printed.
Health54/legacy.fields:H_BHP_PST_SMEAR: The legacy manual's header says 31 fields but its table prints 32; shown as printed.

Health56/legacy.fields:H_BHP_BCS_DATA: The legacy manual's header says 51 fields but its table prints 53; shown as printed (the 2025/06/24 manual declares and prints 49).

Health57/legacy.fields:H_BHP_OMS_CONFIRM: The legacy manual's header says 18 fields but its table prints 19; shown as printed.

Health81/legacy.ref:HOS: The 權屬別 (HOS) code table is printed in other manuals (e.g. Health01), not in this one.

Health99/post-20250624.ref:HOS: The 權屬別 (HOS) code table is printed in other manuals (e.g. Health01), not in this one.

Health103/legacy.ref:CASE_TYPE: AMI_IP.CASE_TYPE refers to the 案件分類 code table of the claims files (Health01/Health02); this manual prints none.

Welfare12/legacy.fields: The header gives two counts, 40 fields for data years 100-107 and 26 from 108; the table lists the 62 columns of all years.

Welfare12/post-20250624.fields: The header counts 26 fields for data years from 108; the table prints 29 numbered rows (rows 25-29 add ID-check columns VVID_ROC, VVID_S, DVID_ROC, DVID_S and ISLIVETOGETHER).

Welfare20/legacy.fields:W_LTC_CMS_CA100: The manual's CA100 header declares 21 fields but its field table prints 20 (and its 備註 column sits one row low from row 8); not recoverable from the PDF. Noted on the site.

Welfare20/post-20250624.fields:W_LTC_CMS_CA100: The manual's CA100 header declares 21 fields but its field table prints 20 (and its 備註 column sits one row low from row 8); not recoverable from the PDF. Noted on the site.
